purposes.tool: A working utility that does a real job people otherwise pay for, sign up for, install or struggle to find free: a calculator, converter, checker, formatter, planner, generator with real output. Correct first, charming second. Runs entirely in the browser, no account, no upload.
purposes.lesson: An interactive lesson that teaches ONE niche concept deeply: plain explanation, manipulable demos, worked examples, check-yourself questions. The visitor's mental model must change.
purposes.explorer: An explorable reference or dataset: a model, map, timeline, table or system the visitor can query and poke, with the story told alongside. All data bundled and sourced.
purposes.studio: A creative workbench that makes something worth keeping or exporting: music, art, type, pattern, palette, text.
purposes.play: A game, toy, satire or experiment whose main point is fun. Welcome, but rare; it must win on merit.
